script: Can you describe your current process for gathering and reporting sustainability data for your annual disclosure?
What challenges do you face when trying to map EU CSRD sustainability-reporting requirements onto your existing ERP data?
How would you prioritize features in a compliance-automation SaaS tool that would make your sustainability reporting process more efficient?
interview_answers:
To be honest, I find it a bit of a challenge. As a factory manager, I'm responsible for ensuring our company meets the EU sustainability reporting requirements, but to be frank, it's not always easy.

Right now, we're using an ERP system that's been with us for years, and while it's great for our core business operations, it's not exactly designed for sustainability data collection. So, I have to manually export data from the ERP into a spreadsheet every quarter, which is time-consuming and prone to errors.

Then, I spend hours reviewing the data, trying to make sense of all the different metrics and KPIs that we need to report on. It's not always clear what's required by the EU CSRD, so it can be confusing at times.

The next step is drafting the annual disclosure document, which involves translating our sustainability data into a format that's compliant with the CSRD requirements. I usually work with our company's compliance officer to ensure everything is accurate and complete, but even with her help, it's still a lot of work.

Overall, my current process feels a bit manual and labor-intensive, and I'm always looking for ways to simplify things and make reporting sustainability data more efficient.

To be honest, it's not just the mapping part that's challenging, but also understanding what exactly is required by the EU CSRD in the first place.

I mean, we have a lot of different systems and departments within our company, each with their own way of collecting and tracking sustainability data. And then you add on top of that the fact that our ERP system isn't specifically designed for this type of reporting... it's just not intuitive to me how all these different pieces fit together.

And even when we try to get clarification from our compliance officer or the EU representatives, it can be tough to understand exactly what's expected. There are so many different metrics and KPIs, and they all seem to have slightly different interpretations. It's like trying to solve a puzzle with missing pieces!

Plus, because we're a mid-sized company, we don't have a huge dedicated team for sustainability reporting, so I'm often having to juggle multiple responsibilities at once. That means I don't always have the bandwidth to focus on mapping and translating data into the CSRD format.

So yeah, it's just a lot of work, and I'm not sure how to make it more efficient without breaking the bank or having someone else do it for me!

Well, to be honest, I'm not sure where to start. But if I had to think about what would really make a difference, I'd say it's all about streamlining the mapping and data collection process.

First of all, I'd want a tool that can automatically connect to our existing ERP system, so I don't have to manually export data every quarter. That would save me a huge amount of time and reduce the risk of errors.

Next, I'd love a feature that can help me identify which sustainability metrics and KPIs are relevant to my company's operations. It feels like there are just too many options out there, and it's hard to know what's really important.

And then there would need to be some kind of validation process to ensure that the data is accurate and complete. I've had issues in the past where we've missed certain metrics or reporting requirements, so a tool that can catch those mistakes before they become part of our annual disclosure document would be a huge help.

I'd also love it if the tool could integrate with other systems and departments within my company, like procurement or supply chain management. That would make it easier to collect and report on sustainability data from multiple sources.

But at the end of the day, I'm not sure what specific features are truly essential. What I really need is for someone to take away some of that manual effort and give me back some of my time. Maybe that's a bit too much to ask?
